name: apple-notes
title: Apple Notes clone
description: Apple Notes: iCloud and On My Mac folders with All iCloud, Recently Deleted and tags; notes grouped Pinned · Today · Previous 7 Days… with snippets, or a gallery of thumbnails; a Markdown note editor with checklists and tables; pin, lock, share, move, delete, search, swipe actions and new notes that spring into place. Three tiled columns on desktop, an overlay sidebar on iPad, a NavigationStack with large titles on iPhone. Composed from SplitView, NavigationStack, List, MarkdownEditor, Segmented and DropdownMenu.
